title: Agents of Desire
sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories
description: Persistent state graph for Agents of Desire. Investigation branches, Agent/personhood truth, optional leads and three authored resolutions are state-owned; narration cannot decide the moral outcome.
premise: Rogue connects the Crew with Kodai Khan, who says his fiancée Aisha 'Ai' Tiang has been kidnapped. The apparently simple recovery job becomes an investigation into memory, identity and an Agent built around a dead woman's engram.
publicBackground: Kodai Khan wants his fiancée Ai recovered and believes she has been kidnapped.
gmBackground: Ai died years ago. Kodai had Lotus LaMarch use Soulkiller; Kodai later came to behave as though Ai were still alive, with an upgraded Agent carrying her persona. The Crew must discover the truth rather than receive it from narration.

startDefinition.openingSituation: Rogue introduces the Crew to a private missing-person job involving Kodai Khan and Ai.

gmGuidance: Keep human Ai's death and the Agent/Soulkiller history sealed until evidence supports revelation.
Do not force a single investigation route: La Lune Bleue, Jane Gatsby, Lotus LaMarch, the Buttkickers and other authored leads may converge on the server farm.
Maurice is a social gate; do not normalize the restaurant into mandatory combat.
The final disposition is a player moral choice. Never let narration choose Till Death Do Us Part, The Charade Continues or The Broken Masquerade.
All skill checks and combat outcomes belong to Rules Engine.
